name: AUM Gan Ganapataye Namo Namaha (chant)
text:
ॐ गं गणपतये नमो नमः
श्री सिद्धिविनायक नमो नमः
अष्टविनायक नमो नमः
गणपती बाप्पा मोरया
meaning: Salutations to Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles. Praise to Siddhi Vinayaka and the eight Vinayakas. Glory to Lord Ganesha, the beloved!
purpose: A popular devotional chant, sung rather than recited.
when: With others, or whenever you want to sing.
note: A popular chant rather than a scriptural verse; its last line is Marathi.
